sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list WASP-14 and BD+22 2716B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 1242084170974175232 and 1242084166679297920), 1,855 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 2.4e-5: the pair is bound.
